review_notes: I read the whole file and checked how unipU is used in this file and in the sibling file _prime_pow.lean. The Ihara transfer lemmas, the SL2 cardinality lemmas and the final theorem have no simp-interface problems that I could support. The finding is about the new definition unipU and its missing simp/coercion API. I did not run Lean. The suggested lemma is stated as rfl on the assumption that the Subtype structure is definitionally unfolded, which I expect but did not test.

findings.problem: The new definition unipU has no basic simp lemma giving its underlying matrix. Because the coercion of unipU is not exposed to simp, the proofs unfold it by hand with `change`. unipU_ne_one does this to the entry (0,1), and the succ case of unipU_pow_coe does it on the product. unipU_pow_coe, the only lemma about the matrix of a power, is also not tagged @[simp]. So `simp` cannot normalise `((unipU q : SL(2, ZMod q)) : Matrix _ _ _)` or `((unipU q ^ n : SL(2, ZMod q)) : Matrix _ _ _)` to `!![1,1;0,1]` or `!![1,(n:ZMod q);0,1]`. The same `change` pattern appears in the sibling file S_Ihara_hasTrivialSchurMultiplier_SL2_ZMod_prime_pow.lean (lines 257 and 267), so the gap is shared.
findings.proposed_change: Directly after `def unipU`, add `@[simp] theorem coe_unipU : ((unipU q : SL(2, ZMod q)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod q)) = !![1, 1; 0, 1] := rfl`. Also mark `unipU_pow_coe` as @[simp]; its right-hand side `!![1,(n:ZMod q);0,1]` is the normal form and the rewrite cannot loop. Then in the succ case replace the `change` with `rw [pow_succ, SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, ih, coe_unipU]`. In unipU_ne_one use `simpa using congrArg (fun g : SL(2, ZMod q) => (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod q)) 0 1) h`.
findings.benefit: The coercion of unipU then has one canonical simp normal form. Proofs about this element no longer rely on `change` and definitional unfolding. Later uses of unipU (the sibling prime-power file defines the same element) can rely on `simp`.

evidence.excerpt: theorem unipU_ne_one [Fact q.Prime] : unipU q ≠ 1 := by
change ((unipU q ^ n : SL(2, ZMod q)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod q)) * !![1, 1; 0, 1] = _
